title: Under Whelmed
text: Under Whelmed. I wanted a nice neutral runner for the entry way. I was under whelmed by this. It's thin and too boring for the entry space. It would be fine for a more utilitarian purpose such as a laundry room or garage. The design is barely noticeable. I will keep looking.

product_metadata.title: Cekene Runner Rug for Hallways Area Rug Runner Washable Runner Mat Non Slip for Entryway Entrance Kitchen Laundry Room 23”x59”, Camel
features: 【Perfect Size&Low Pile】--The runner rug measures 2'x5'(60x150cm), featuring a low-profile design. Perfect size for your hallway and any other high traffic area in your home. Package includes 1 Cekene area rug runner. WARM NOTE: The carpet runner is folded in package, please iron the kitchen runner rug at a low to medium heat to flatten if there’s crease on it after receiving.

【Qualified&Durable Material】--The area rug runner is made of high quality polypropylene, non odor, toxic-free, non-shedding. It can scrape dirt, dust, sand and absorb moisture from your shoes as well. Moreover, the premium material also makes the kitchen carpet runner long-lasting and durable, you do not need to replace it frequently.

【Non Slip Rug Runner】--The standing floor mat applies TPR backing technology and can stay in place on various floors, e.g. wooden, marble, tile floor, etc., ensuring the safety of you, your family and pets. WARM NOTE: Please place the runner rug on dry, clean, smooth floor only, otherwise, it may not non-slip.

【Easy to Clean&Fiber-locking】--The upgrading fiber-locking technology adopted makes the polypropylene fiber solid and not easy to fall off, which has solved the problem of large amount of fibers falling from the laundry room rug. Therefore, when it gets dirty, you can simply clean with a hand-held vacuum, sweep with a broom, or use the washing machine for deeper cleaning.

【Versatile Runner Rug】--The Cekene runner mat for entryway is perfect for various situations: it can be used as runner rugs for hallways, entryway runner carpet, indoor entrance doormats; it can also be put in your kitchen, laundry room, etc. Moreover, you can get the rug runner for hallway as a gift for your beloved family and friends. Very practical and worth-buying products!
